jobs.title: SENIOR ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENTIST (SUPERVISORY)
jobs.description:
Job Posting: Salton Sea Program Supervisor, Planning and Permitting



Department of Fish and Wildlife


JC\-508696* 

Salton Sea Program Supervisor, Planning and Permitting
  

SENIOR ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENTIST (SUPERVISORY)
$10,854\.00 \- $13,493\.00 per Month
  

New to State candidates will be hired into the minimum salary of the classification or minimum of alternate range when applicable.


**Final Filing Date:** **8/10/2026**


### **Job Description and Duties**


Are you ready to step up into a leadership position? Does supervising a dynamic team working on restoration projects around the Salton Sea excite you? Do you enjoy a face\-paced, very dynamic and interesting position that will challenge your current skills and require you to learn more?
  

  

If you answered yes to any of these questions, then you might be right for the the Salton Sea Program Supervisor position. We are looking for a positive leader who believes in the CDFW motto and enjoys working with both nature and people. Liking the desert would be an added bonus.
  

  

Under the general direction of the Salton Sea Program Manager (C.E.A.), the incumbent supervises and directs the work of professional scientific staff and technicians directly responsible for the technical and professional development of staff, performance evaluation, program budgeting, and work force planning for the program.
  

  

Senior Environmental Scientist (Supervisory): Exam Bulletin Link  

  

  



This position is being re\-advertised. If you previously applied, your application is being considered and you do not need to re\-apply.
You will find additional information about the job in the **Duty Statement**.


### **Working Conditions**


Ability to use a computer keyboard for several hours each day; complete office tasks that require sitting, standing, and walking to other locations; attend meetings and conference calls; visit project sites requiring driving a vehicle up to three or more hours each way and sometimes including early mornings and late nights; occasional overnight travel up to 20% to reach some meeting or field locations; hiking over uneven and possibly steep or wet terrain at project sites for reconnaissance and biological monitoring; including operation or passenger on a boat; occasional travel of two or more days per week. This position offers the possibility of an office\-centered hybrid telework agreement based on the Department's current Telework Policy. The position will require, at times, the incumbent to wear a uniform identifying the employee as CDFW staff.

Department of Fish and Wildlife (CDFW) employees are committed to managing and protecting California’s diverse wildlife and the habitats upon which they depend.  

California is one of the most biodiverse places on the planet. As such, CDFW values diverse employees working together to protect nature for all Californians. CDFW is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment where all backgrounds, cultures and personal experiences can thrive and connect others to our critical mission.  

Join us and begin a meaningful new career!

jobs.title: Senior Hydrogeologist (Seller-Doer) – California (Remote/Hybrid)
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity:**
Tetra Tech is adding an experienced leader to serve as a ***Senior Hydrogeologist (Seller\-Doer)*** to support and expand our Environmental Investigation and Remediation practice throughout California, with potential growth into other regions across the United States. This role may be remote or hybrid, with access to our California offices.  

This is a unique opportunity to join a nationally recognized consulting firm and play a key leadership role in developing client relationships, winning new work, and delivering high\-quality technical services across the Commercial, Industrial, Government, Energy, and Transportation sectors. **Why Tetra Tech:**
At Tetra Tech, we are *Leading with Science* to solve the world’s most complex challenges. Our industry\-leading experts in engineering and consulting are committed to driving positive change in communities around the world. For over 50 years, we have been at the forefront of innovation and sustainability. Today we stand as a market leader, offering cutting\-edge solutions in water, environment, energy, and international development. Our work has improved more than 625 million lives around the world. **Your Impact:**
Join Tetra Tech to make a real difference. Our work leverages cutting\-edge technologies, advanced analytics, and the expertise of world\-class scientists and engineers to create meaningful change around the world. Discover your full potential – join us to advance your career while leaving a lasting legacy. **Position Summary**
The Senior Hydrogeologist (Seller\-Doer) will provide technical leadership, business development, and project execution for environmental investigation and remediation programs. This role combines client\-facing sales, technical excellence, and team leadership, and serves as a key contributor to regional and national growth. **Essential Job Functions:****Business Development*** Build and expand an environmental investigation and remediation client portfolio through new client acquisition and repeat business.
* Partner with National Account Managers to position Tetra Tech for multinational and strategic client opportunities.
* Lead business development efforts within the Commercial, Industrial, Energy, and Transportation sectors.
* Develop marketing strategies, proposals, technical presentations, trade show participation, and client meetings.
* Foster strong relationships with clients, regulators, and project stakeholders.
* Conduct activities in line with internal procedures, legislation, and industry standards.
* Pursue continuous professional development and maintain a high degree of discipline\-specific knowledge and awareness.
* Work in a safe manner at all times and report all health and safety incidents and concerns.
* Additional duties as required.

 **Leadership \& Project Management*** Manage staff workload including staffing plans, proposals, deliverables, QA/QC, and backlog forecasting.
* Lead and motivate multidisciplinary project teams to meet project goals and milestones.
* Direct and manage marketing and business development efforts within the Commercial Program practice.
* Set and manage project expectations, budgets, schedules, and performance.
* Serve as Project Manager for environmental investigation and remediation projects.

 **Hydrogeology Expertise*** Provide hydrogeologic technical leadership to complex investigation and remediation projects.
* Lead field hydrogeologic investigations including aquifer testing and site characterization.
* Develop conceptual site models.
* Prepare boring logs and well construction diagrams using gINT or similar software.
* Apply groundwater modeling and fate and transport modeling.
* Author and review technical reports, plans, memoranda, and specifications.
* Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for clients, technical teams, and leadership.

 **Required Qualifications:*** Bachelor’s Degree in Geology, Hydrogeology, or related field (required).
* Professional Geologist (PG) or Certified Hydrogeologist (CHg) license in California (required).
* 10–20 years of progressive consulting experience in geology/hydrogeology.
* Demonstrated business development and client relationship experience.
* Experience with CERCLA, RCRA, DTSC, California Water Board, and other CalEPA programs.
* Ability to mentor and lead engineers, geologists, scientists, and technicians.
* Strong project management, organizational, and time management skills.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.
* Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and perform under pressure.
* Must possess a valid driver’s license with a clean driving record without restrictions.

 **Preferred Qualifications:*** Master’s Degree in Geology, Hydrogeology, or related field.
* PMP Certification.
* Experience with groundwater modeling and fate and transport modeling.
* Experience leading large, multi\-disciplinary remediation programs.
* Experience working with public and private sector clients in California.

 **Physical Requirements:*** Ability to conduct fieldwork at project sites, including standing, walking, bending, and climbing.
* Ability to lift and carry field equipment up to approximately 30 pounds.
* Ability to work in outdoor conditions during site investigations.
* Ability to sit for extended periods while performing office and computer\-based work.

 **Work Environment / Environmental Factors:*** Work may be performed in a combination of office, remote/home office, and field environments.
* Field environments may include industrial facilities, active remediation sites, construction areas, and undeveloped terrain.
* Travel for site visits, client meetings, and business development is required periodically.
* Exposure to outdoor weather conditions and environmental hazards consistent with investigation and remediation work.

jobs.title: Contingency Management Program Coordinator (Spanish-Language Stimulant Use Program)
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Contingency Management (CM) Program Coordinator is responsible for the day\-to\-day coordination, implementation, and administration of The Gubbio Project's Spanish\-language, culturally responsive Contingency Management Program for people who use stimulants. Working collaboratively with the San Francisco AIDS Foundation (SFAF), the San Francisco Department of Public Health (SFDPH), and community partners, the Coordinator ensures that participants receive high\-quality, trauma\-informed, harm reduction\-focused services in a welcoming and culturally responsive environment.

The Coordinator oversees program logistics, participant engagement, incentive management, data collection, reporting, and collaboration with clinical partners to ensure successful implementation and positive participant outcomes. The program is designed to provide three 12\-person cohorts annually, combining Spanish\-language group sessions, individual support, clinical services, and incentive\-based engagement.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Program Coordination**

* Coordinate all aspects of the Contingency Management Program.
* Manage participant enrollment, scheduling, attendance, and program documentation.
* Coordinate three annual 12\-week cohorts.
* Prepare program materials and participant packets.
* Ensure smooth daily operations and adherence to program policies.
* Maintain confidentiality and compliance with HIPAA and agency policies.

**Participant Engagement**

* Build trusting, respectful relationships using trauma\-informed and harm reduction principles.
* Welcome and orient new participants.
* Provide ongoing encouragement and motivational support.
* Conduct regular participant wellness check\-ins.
* Assist participants with referrals to healthcare, behavioral health, housing, treatment, and social services.
* Coordinate with Partner Agencies on referrals supporting the participants.
* Promote participant retention throughout the program.

**Partnership Coordination**

* Serve as the primary administrative liaison between The Gubbio Project, SFAF, and SFDPH.
* Coordinate scheduling with facilitators, clinicians, and outreach staff.
* Attend multidisciplinary team meetings.
* Support communication between all program partners.

**Incentive Management**

* Manage Contingency Management incentive distribution.
* Maintain accurate inventory and secure storage of gift cards and participant incentives.
* Track participant milestones and incentive eligibility.
* Ensure compliance with funding requirements and audit standards.

**Data Collection \& Reporting**

* Maintain accurate participant records.
* Track attendance, incentives, outcomes, and engagement.
* Prepare reports required by SFDPH and funding partners.
* Assist with program evaluation and quality improvement.
* Monitor program performance measures.

**Group \& Event Support**

* Assist with Spanish\-language group logistics.
* Coordinate participant Water, coffee, meals, and supplies.
* Support educational workshops and wellness activities.
* Ensure meeting spaces are prepared and welcoming.
* Maintain an information table with updated printed Spanish information on services and resources.
* Set up and clean up of the group session space

**Administrative Responsibilities**

* Purchase program supplies and meals.
* Manage program calendars.
* Maintain organized files and documentation.
* Assist with grant reporting and compliance activities.
* Support budget tracking related to program expenses.
* Coordinate PROGRESA team meetings, take notes, and follow up on action items and agreements.

**Qualifications**

**Required** 

* Bachelor's degree in Social Work, Public Health, Human Services, or related field (or equivalent lived and professional experience).
* Minimum 2 years of experience in case management, harm reduction, behavioral health, community outreach, or program coordination.
* **Fluent in both English and Spanish (written and verbal). Speaking Maya from Yucatan is a plus.**
* Experience working with individuals experiencing homelessness, substance use, or behavioral health challenges and with Latine Immigrants and indigenous people from Latin America.
* Strong organizational and administrative skills.
* Excellent communication and relationship\-building abilities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Contingency Management programs.
* Knowledge of stimulant use treatment and harm reduction.
* Familiarity with San Francisco service systems.
* Experience with data management and grant reporting.
* CPR/First Aid and Naloxone certification (or willingness to obtain).

**Core Competencies**

* Harm Reduction Philosophy
* Trauma\-Informed Care
* Motivational Interviewing
* Cultural Humility
* Participant Engagement
* Collaboration and Teamwork
* Strong Organizational Skills
* Professional Documentation
* Confidentiality and Ethics
* Conflict Resolution and De\-escalation

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to lift up to 25 pounds.
* Ability to stand, walk, and move throughout the program site for extended periods.
* Ability to work in both indoor and outdoor environments.
* Ability to interact respectfully with individuals experiencing behavioral health crises.

**Working Conditions**

The Gubbio Project is a low\-barrier, community\-based drop\-in center serving people experiencing homelessness, housing instability, and substance use. Staff work in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment where flexibility, compassion, professionalism, and strong boundaries are essential.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* Harm Reduction: 2 years (Required)

Language:

* Spanish (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Jr. Geospatial Analyst - DHS
jobs.description:
cFocus Software seeks a Jr. Geospatial Analyst to join our program supporting the Department of Homeland Security (DHS). This position is remote. This position requires a Public Trust Clearance.  

  

**Qualifications:*** Bachelor’s or master’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Geography or a related field.
* 1\-3 years of relevant professional, internship, academic, military, or project experience in GIS, geospatial analysis, cartography, data management, or location intelligence.
* Foundational experience using ESRI technology such as ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise/Portal, ArcGIS Online, web maps, hosted feature layers, Dashboards, or comparable GIS tools.
* Understanding of spatial data concepts, coordinate systems, projections, geocoding, vector and raster data, attributes, metadata, data quality, and basic spatial analysis.
* Ability to work with common tabular, JSON, web\-service, and geospatial formats and to organize and validate data systematically.
* Basic experience with Python, ArcGIS Notebooks, SQL, Arcade, or another scripting/query language used for data processing or GIS automation.
* Strong attention to detail, analytical reasoning, documentation, organization, communication, and willingness to learn in a collaborative Agile environment.
* Ability to satisfy DHS suitability, background\-investigation, Entry on Duty, security, and system\-access requirements for the assigned position.

**Duties:*** Acquire, receive, organize, process, update, and maintain geospatial and operational datasets supporting DHS GMO mission programs.
* Prepare data for upload, publication, visualization, analysis, sharing, archival, and retrieval within ESRI Portal, ArcGIS Online, GII repositories, and other approved environments.
* Perform routine geoprocessing, spatial analysis, data conversion, coordinate validation, field mapping, joins, selections, overlays, and other assigned GIS production activities.
* Query and maintain archived geospatial information in open, accessible, and available standards and support applicable data backup, recovery, and records\-retention activities.
* Follow established naming conventions, folder and repository structures, versioning practices, access restrictions, and data\-handling procedures
* Perform data\-quality assurance and quality\-control checks for completeness, accuracy, consistency, currency, schema compliance, geometry, attribution, duplication, and usability.
* Document data\-quality findings, corrections, assumptions, limitations, source lineage, and unresolved issues; escalate material concerns to senior staff.
* Create and maintain dataset, service, and database metadata in accordance with DHS geospatial methodologies, approved standards, and program procedures.
* Assist with database metadata design, repository maintenance, data dictionaries, field definitions, source descriptions, terms of use, points of contact, and update schedules.
* Support reconciliation of published layers, web services, source data, metadata, and related documentation so that information remains accurate and traceable.
* Design, configure, publish, and maintain web maps, hosted layers, and geospatial services under established technical and governance procedures.
* Configure appropriate symbology, labeling, pop\-ups, filters, fields, scales, legends, and other presentation settings to meet user and mission requirements.
* Create and update ArcGIS Dashboards that present real\-time information, key performance indicators, status, trends, and operational context.
* Assist with Experience Builder applications and other ESRI web experiences by configuring maps, widgets, data sources, layouts, and user\-facing content.
* Validate that published products display accurate information, perform as expected, and support applicable accessibility, security, and user requirements
* Participate in requirements discussions and translate stakeholder data, mapping, visualization, and reporting needs into documented Jira stories, tasks, acceptance criteria, and data specifications.
* Execute assigned manual and automated test cases for data workflows, maps, layers, dashboards, services, and geospatial applications; record results and document defects.
* Support user acceptance, integration, regression, data\-quality, and operational testing and verify that corrections meet defined requirements.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, backlog refinement, demonstrations, reviews, and retrospectives; keep assigned work and blockers current in Jira.
* Use Confluence, GitLab, and other Government\-approved tools to maintain documentation, scripts, configuration items, decisions, and work products

jobs.title: SUE (Subsurface Utility Engineering) Data Analyst/GIS Specialist
jobs.description:
Join Colliers Engineering \& Design as a SUE Data Analyst/GIS Specialist and play a key role in shaping the future of infrastructure. In this dynamic position, you’ll transform complex subsurface utility engineering (SUE) data into clear, actionable insights that drive smarter design and reduce risk on critical projects. Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, you’ll leverage cutting\-edge tools and geospatial technologies to ensure data accuracy, enhance project efficiency, and support innovative engineering solutions. If you thrive at the intersection of data, technology, and real\-world impact, this is your opportunity to make a tangible difference.  

* Attend project kickoff meetings (in person or virtually) to coordinate project workflows.
* Assist in development of SUE GIS Database.
* Provide oversight of SUE GIS Data Collection Program.
* Setup and maintain project applications in Basecamp, Fulcrum, Bluebeam or similar.
* Receive and process field data from Fulcrum, Basecamp, Bluebeam and/or other software applications as developed.
* QA/QC data received and determine need for remedial collection as necessary. Provide updates on data collection to project team as well as any need for additional data.
* Coordinate with survey staff to ensure proper survey collection of utility data, provide survey staff with package of Fulcrum, Bluebeam and Basecamp data to facilitate data collection.
* Coordinate with CADD staff for drafting of utility data, provide package of Fulcrum, Bluebeam and Basecamp data to facilitate drafting and review.
* Coordinate with project team to review all data collected, QA/QC output, review CADD drafting and ensure quality of data for client deliverable.
* Coordinate with departmental admin staff to organize and maintain proper filing of project and general information.
* Attend conferences and training seminars as necessary to learn of new applications and equipment in the utility space to maintain competitive edge in marketplace.
* Provide clients with proper back\-up data (designating reports, test hole reports, field sketches, CAD files, etc.).
* Coordinate with local municipalities to obtain proper certifications and permits for SUE work in their jurisdictions.

  

* Associates Degree required, Bachelors degree preferred.
* 5\+ years of experience in SUE or closely related field.
* ESRI ARC GIS experience a plus.
* CADD experience preferred (Microstation or AutoCAD Civil 3D).
* Interpersonal skills, ability to effectively work well with and communicate with others.
* Strong written and oral communication skill.
* Strong organizational skills with a keen ability to prioritize and multi\-task.
* Proficient in MS Office, BlueBeam, Fulcrum and/or other related software.
* Excel in the ability to learn, apply and teach others technical skills and knowledge.
* Keen eye for detail.
* Ability to read, write and understand English for purposes of comprehending written job\-related communications and verbal instructions and interactions.
